cds.title: St. Mary's University Common Data Set 2025-2026 (PDF)

consumer.title: St. Mary's University - Consumer Information (Fall 2025 enrollment, student-to-teacher ratio)

stats.notes: Read from the CDS form fields (C1, C9, C11, C12). The university's Consumer Information page lists slightly different first-year counts (4,267 applied, 4,055 admitted, 566 enrolled); the CDS figures are used here. International row: 427 applicants, 378 admitted. C9: 218 SAT and 55 ACT submitters among 569 enrollees (percent not stated reliably, so pct_submit is omitted). No wait list; no early decision or early action. SAT total (composite) percentiles are not published, only ERW and Math. Undergraduate enrollment 2,330 and the 11:1 ratio are from the university's Consumer Information page (fall 2025); 123 nonresident undergraduates are from CDS B2.

cds_test_policy.notes: CDS C8A: not required for admission, but considered if submitted; students applying without scores submit a personal statement.

cost.notes: CDS G1 (full 2026-2027 year): tuition $38,404, required fees $1,478, food and housing $13,438; books $1,300. CDS H6: 55 degree-seeking nonresidents received institutional aid, average $42,263 (total $2,324,499) for the aid year the CDS marks as 2023-24; the CDS does not say whether this is need-based or merit aid.
